name: calendar-deepseek
title: Calendar_Deepseek
description: Smart create calendar events from clipboard text or event posters
author: lovis_yang

preferences.name: visionModel
preferences.title: Vision Model
preferences.description: Model used to read posters. Change it if the experimental model id stops working.

preferences.name: imageDetail
preferences.title: Poster Detail
preferences.description: High keeps the original resolution; low downscales to 512x512 for a faster, cheaper call.

preferences.name: enableOcr
preferences.title: Poster OCR
preferences.label: Add on-device OCR text to poster requests
preferences.description: Runs the macOS Vision framework locally and sends the recognized text alongside the image. Improves accuracy on dense small print.

commands.name: calendar
commands.title: Calendar
commands.subtitle: Use DeepSeek to help create calendar events from text or a poster
commands.description: Smart create calendar events from clipboard text or an event poster with DeepSeek

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
